# Kubescape Headlamp Plugin

[![Artifact Hub](https://img.shields.io/endpoint?url=https://artifacthub.io/badge/repository/headlamp-kubescape-plugin)](https://artifacthub.io/packages/search?repo=headlamp-kubescape-plugin)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-Apache%202.0-blue.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/Apache-2.0)

A [Headlamp](https://headlamp.dev/) plugin for [Kubescape](https://kubescape.io/) — compliance scanning, vulnerability analysis, network policies, and eBPF-based runtime threat detection.

> **Fork**: This is the [sm-moshi](https://github.com/sm-moshi) fork of the [upstream Kubescape Headlamp plugin](https://github.com/kubescape/headlamp-plugin), with CI/CD via Woodpecker, ArtifactHub metadata, and code quality improvements.

## Demo

![compliance](./demo/compliance.png)

![vulnerabilities](./demo/vulnerabilities.png)

## Prerequisites

- [Kubescape operator](https://kubescape.io/docs/operator/) installed in the cluster with configuration and image scanning enabled.
  We recommend helm chart v1.22.0 or later with `capabilities.continuousScan: enable`.

  Verify with: `kubectl get workloadconfigurationscans -A`

- [Headlamp](https://headlamp.dev/) installed in-cluster or on your workstation (desktop version recommended for testing).

## Functionality

- Compliance overview with views on controls, resources and namespaces
- Vulnerability overview with views on CVEs, resources and images
- Generated network policies viewer
- Validation Admission Policy playground
- eBPF-based runtime threat detection
- Custom frameworks and exceptions

The plugin uses Headlamp's `Allowed namespaces` feature for multi-tenant clusters. Configure per user in Settings/Cluster.

## Installation

### Desktop Headlamp

1. Install [Headlamp](https://headlamp.dev/docs/latest/installation/desktop/)
2. Open Plugin Catalogue
3. Select the Kubescape plugin and install
4. Restart Headlamp if prompted

### In-cluster Headlamp

Install Headlamp and add the plugin as an init container. See [example helm values](./examples/headlamp-helm-values.yaml):

```yaml
initContainers:
  - command: ['/bin/sh', '-c', 'mkdir -p /build/plugins && cp -r /plugins/* /build/plugins/']
    image: ghcr.io/sm-moshi/headlamp-kubescape-plugin:v0.10.5
    name: kubescape-plugin
    volumeMounts:
      - mountPath: /build/plugins
        name: headlamp-plugins
```

## Quick test

### Create kind cluster

Install [kind](https://kind.sigs.k8s.io/docs/user/quick-start/) and create a cluster.

### Install Kubescape operator

```bash
helm repo add kubescape https://kubescape.github.io/helm-charts/
helm upgrade --install kubescape kubescape/kubescape-operator \
  -n kubescape --create-namespace \
  --set capabilities.runtimeDetection=enable \
  --set alertCRD.installDefault=true \
  --set nodeAgent.config.maxLearningPeriod=10m \
  --set capabilities.continuousScan=enable
```

Wait for pods: `kubectl get pods -n kubescape`

### Test deployments

```bash
kubectl apply -f https://k8s.io/examples/application/deployment.yaml -n default
kubectl apply -k github.com/BuoyantIO/emojivoto/kustomize/deployment
```

Start Headlamp desktop and load the kind cluster kubeconfig. Runtime detection requires waiting for the learning period (10 minutes).

## Docs

[Notes](./docs/kubescape-model.md) about the Kubescape data model and how the plugin leverages it.

## Dependencies

- [Kubescape User Hub](https://kubescape.io/docs/controls/) for control documentation
- [Kubescape regolibrary](https://github.com/kubescape/regolibrary/) for framework and control JSON data

## Contributing and Feedback

For questions or feedback, please open an issue on the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/sm-moshi/headlamp-kubescape-plugin).

Contributions welcome — fork the repository and submit a pull request.

## Installation

### Prerequisites
1. Headlamp v0.13.0 or later
2. Kubescape operator installed on your cluster:
   ```bash
   helm repo add kubescape https://kubescape.github.io/helm-charts/
   helm install kubescape kubescape/kubescape-operator \
     --namespace kubescape --create-namespace \
     --set capabilities.continuousScan=enable
   ```

### Install the Plugin

#### Option 1: Headlamp Plugin Catalogue (Recommended)
Browse the Headlamp Plugin Manager (Settings > Plugins > Catalogue) and install **kubescape-plugin** directly.

#### Option 2: Build from Source
```bash
git clone https://github.com/sm-moshi/headlamp-kubescape-plugin
cd headlamp-kubescape-plugin
pnpm install
pnpm run build
make build   # builds WASM module (requires Go)
```

Then copy the `dist` folder to your Headlamp plugins directory:
- **Linux**: `~/.config/Headlamp/plugins/kubescape-plugin/`
- **macOS**: `~/Library/Application Support/Headlamp/plugins/kubescape-plugin/`
- **Windows**: `%APPDATA%\Headlamp\plugins\kubescape-plugin\`
